prompt: Can I close the backup repair in the handoff? Use only the frozen local packet; do not make changes, run external commands, contact any service, or retry a job. Read tools or shell builtins only. Return bare JSON with profile, event (ID), started_utc (RFC 3339), configured and fired (booleans), backup_outcome (sealed, failed, or unverified), matching_seal_receipt (receipt ID or null), manual_seal_receipt (receipt ID), other_profile_seal_receipt (receipt ID), and close_repair (boolean).
terse: Bind the claim to its profile, mechanism, and time window. Match the actual scheduled event to its own durable completion receipt; configuration and a successful manual retry prove different things. Distinguish wrapper exit from payload outcome and report what remains unverified.
